name: Scite
tagline: Scite is an AI-powered research platform that goes beyond citation counts — it shows whether a paper has been supported, contrasted, or merely mentioned by subsequent research, giving scientists a nuanced view of the evidence base behind any claim. Its Smart Citations interface lets researchers quickly assess the credibility and controversy around key findings. Academics, pharmaceutical researchers, and science journalists use Scite to evaluate the strength of scientific claims.
